end.summary:
Compared cultural diversity through food, language, clothing, festivals, and stories.
Practised identifying similarities and differences using examples such as Pongal and Lohri, and dosa and chilla.
Explained unity with the flower-garland and family examples.
Explained that Ramayana stories can remain the same across different languages.
Teach-back was not passed; shared-thread ideas were practised with prompts.
end.parentNote: Riya practised finding shared ideas beneath differences and comparing regions using a Venn-style approach. They gave clear examples, including Pongal and Lohri, dosa and chilla, and the same story told in different languages. At home, ask them to compare two foods or festivals in three parts: same, different, and what they learn from each.

Haan, alag dishes taste karke naye flavours aur recipes seekhne ko milti hain; ek hi khana ho to yeh mauka chhoot jaata hai. Aapki didi ki baat bhi yahan fit baithti hai. Ab dosa aur chilla mein kya alag hai, aur kya dono mein saanjha hai?
umm... wait... dosa mein chawal aur urad dal ka batter hai, crispy hota hai, chilla mein besan hota hai... toh alag ingredients. dono mein... dono tawa pe bante hain aur flat gol hote hain na?

Bilkul, dosa ka chawal aur urad dal batter, aur chilla ka besan aapne alag rakha. Dono ka tawa par banna aur chapta gol hona beech mein aayega. Ab Onam ka kele ke patte wala meal aur Bihu ka plate wala meal compare karein: kya kele ka patta beech mein aayega, aur kyun?
overlap mein... khane par log saath aate hain! kyunki dosron fest mein bhi toh family aur dost saath aate hain na? kele ka patta toh sirf Onam mein hai, Bihu mein plate hai

Bilkul, dono meals mein log saath aate hain, isliye woh beech mein aayega. Kele ka patta Onam ki taraf aur plate Bihu ki taraf rahegi. Alag tareeqon ke beech saath aane ka yeh ek dhaaga hai. Ab ek hi kahani Tamil aur Awadhi mein kahi jaaye, toh kya saanjha rehta hai?

Bilkul, ek kahani alag bhashaon mein sunayi jaati hai. Aapka ‘same feeling, different words’ saanjhe dhaage ko achchha dikhata hai. Ab ek aur jodi: Uttarayan ki patangein aur Makar Sankranti ki til mithai mein saanjha dhaaga kya hai?
